segments.label: NEWS
segments.headline: Genie 4: a world you can steer

beats.narration: This robot arm isn't real. Neither is the lab. Genie 4, a new world model from DeepMind, made it.
direct: This robot arm isn't real. Neither is the lab. Genie 4, a new world model from DeepMind, made it.

beats.narration: A world model generates a world as you move through it, like a game with no game engine.
direct: A world model generates a world as you move through it, like a game with no game engine.

beats.narration: People steer it with the keyboard, and change the scene with text prompts.
direct: People steer it with the keyboard, and change the scene with text prompts.

beats.narration: So why would robots need it? DeepMind says it can help build robot training environments.
direct: So why would robots need it? DeepMind says it can help build robot training environments.

beats.narration: Like a flight simulator: a safe place to practice.
direct: Like a flight simulator: a safe place to practice.

beats.narration: It even simulated a humanoid robot, Apptronik's Apollo, playing checkers.

visual.credit: Video still: Google DeepMind · Generated by Genie 4

direct: It even simulated a humanoid robot, Apptronik's Apollo, playing checkers.

beats.narration: Reality check. These clips are generated. No robot is reported trained in it, and there are no benchmarks.

visual.text: No robot reported trained in it

direct: Reality check. These clips are generated. No robot is reported trained in it, and there are no benchmarks.

beats.narration: For now, Genie 4 is a research preview.
direct: For now, Genie 4 is a research preview.
